Sept signes neufs face au parent (lettres plutôt que notes vocales, bibliothèques plutôt que centres commerciaux, thé et pluie, vieilles cartes postales, noms des compositeurs, jeunesse des grands-parents, carnet de citations). slides.texte_overlay:
7 signs you're an old soul
(and why it's a compliment)

1. you'd rather send a letter
than a voice note

2. a library feels better
than a mall

3. tea and rain are your idea
of a perfect afternoon

slides.texte_sophia:
4. you trade the evening scroll
for 5 minutes on an app
like Sophia.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. you keep old postcards
and photographs

6. you know the names of
the composers you love

7. you ask your grandparents
about their youth
save this if you felt seen
